pull_request.title: Accept default-branch credential exposure in yolo mode
pull_request.body: Yolo permits Tend to merge ordinary code into the default branch, so a generic deployment credential available to that branch is already exposed to bot-merged code. Accept that exposure without requiring a reviewer for every deploy. Keep Tend's own operational credential checks, admin-gated tags, and reviewer gates for credentials restricted to bot-inaccessible refs.
